//: Every key below is supplied per environment and is intentionally empty here. Deployed environments receive them as App Service application settings written by infrastructure (infra: deploy/bicep/modules/compute/appService.bicep); local development fills them in appsettings.Development.json. An empty value is not a usable default: the code throws when a required key is missing outside Development.
